name: std::indirect_unary_predicate

declarations.code:
template <class F, class I>

concept indirect_unary_predicate =

    std::indirectly_readable<I> &&

    std::copy_constructible<F> &&

    std::predicate<F &, /*indirect-value-t*/<I>> &&

    std::predicate<F &, std::iter_reference_t<I>>;

intro: The concept indirect_unary_predicate specifies requirements for algorithms that call unary predicates as their arguments. The key difference between this concept and std::predicate is that it is applied to the type that I references, rather than I itself.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: An int pointer iterates over {3, 7} and satisfies indirect_unary_predicate.
